title: Not the same as ordering directly from GQ
text: My husband loves the box, but I feel it's important to note that you do not get the same advantages as you would get by ordering directly with GQ. From what I can tell, you do not have access to their discount store (even though you get a brochure and QR code included in your box, as if you were a regular subscriber). And you also do not get the two free gifts that you get when you first sign up on GQ. Overall, definitely a great box, but as a new subscriber, there are better benefits to ordering directly through GQ.
label: neutral
